variants.label: Hopewind protocol 0237 family with opt-in power controls

notes: Local telemetry uses the manufacturer's Hopewind protocol 0237 through the generic Modbus catalog driver.
Runtime identifies a protocol family, not an exact retail model. AC generation is not household load or a site grid-import/export measurement.

known_limitations: Three document-backed untested controls require Full Control: active-power mode and ratio, reactive-power mode. Readback is confirmed; local write application is not.
Absolute-power and signed reactive/power-factor writes are not included. Existing settings can be read; no protection, start/stop, reset or grid-code writes are exposed.
Serial number, packed firmware versions and boot/shutdown timestamps are not decoded; raw support evidence retains their registers.
Additional MPPT/string and fault-word sensors are disabled by default; raw fault words are not decoded alarm descriptions.
Cloud analysis is independent; no further cloud credentials are needed for local polling.
knowledge_summary: Successful FC03 reads match protocol 567/0237 telemetry and two power-settings blocks. PV, AC generation, frequency, temperature and energy are available; three documented power controls are opt-in and untested.
